# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated directory of 957 AI agent tools for builders and ready-to-use products. Facts are verified; pricing is as makers state it.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com

## Machine-readable catalog

- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): full catalog
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml): all public pages

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)

- [Skywork](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/skywork.html) (added 2026-10-18): AI workspace agents that turn a prompt into docs, slides, sheets, podcasts and web pages backed by deep research.
- [Airtop](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/airtop.html) (added 2026-10-18): Turns plain-English workflow descriptions into deterministic agents that work across your apps, APIs and the web.
- [Restack](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/restack.html) (added 2026-10-18): Platform for designing, testing and running reliable agents at enterprise scale on Kubernetes.
- [Cognigy](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/cognigy.html) (added 2026-10-18): NiCE Cognigy's enterprise customer service platform with generative and conversational AI agents across voice and chat.
- [Hume AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/hume-ai.html) (added 2026-10-18): Voice AI company focused on emotionally intelligent speech, with voice-native evaluation and human judgment tooling for voice agents.
- [Arize AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/arize-ai.html) (added 2026-10-18): Agent observability and evaluation platform with tracing, evals and experiments for improving AI agents.
- [WRITER](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/writer.html) (added 2026-10-18): Enterprise AI agent platform for teams to run on-brand, compliant work with agents built on WRITER's own models.
- [TRAE](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/trae.html) (added 2026-10-18): AI coding IDE and agent that works alongside you in your editor to write, edit and run code.
- [UiPath](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/uipath.html) (added 2026-10-18): Enterprise automation platform that orchestrates AI agents, software robots and people across business processes with security and compliance controls.
- [Agentforce](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/agentforce.html) (added 2026-10-18): Salesforce's platform for building and customizing autonomous AI agents that support employees and customers around the clock inside the Salesforce ecosystem.
- [Nooks](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/nooks.html) (added 2026-10-18): Revenue platform whose AI agents dial, sequence, follow up and prep deals alongside sales reps.
- [Bland AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/bland-ai.html) (added 2026-10-18): Enterprise voice AI platform for building, deploying and monitoring phone agents with self-hosted models.
